name_zh: 弗洛伊德/奥地利/精神分析/潜意识/梦/性/维也纳/犹太/伦敦
description_zh: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德（1856-1939），奥地利犹太精神病医师，现代心理学的创始人，弗洛伊德精神分析学派创始人，精神分析理论体系构建者，潜意识/梦的解析/性心理学理论建立者，维也纳精神分析学派领袖，later 移居伦敦，领导犹太流亡精神治疗工作，提出俄狄浦斯情结/泛性论/精神传导理论，出版《梦的解析》/《性学三论》/《精神传导论》，其理论对现代心理学/文化研究/哲学产生深远影响。
description_en: Sigmund Freud (1856-1939), Austrian Jewish psychiatrist, founder of modern psychology, founder of Freud psychoanalysis school, mental analysis theory system constructor, unconscious/dream interpretation/sexology theory founder, leader of Vienna psychoanalysis school, later emigrated to London, led Jewish exile mental treatment work, proposed Oedipus complex/generality theory/psychical transmission theory, published "The Interpretation of Dreams"/"Three Essays on the Theory of Sexuality"/"Psychical Transmission Theory", his theory profoundly influenced modern psychology/cultural studies/philosophy.
reason_zh: 弗洛伊德是现代心理学和精神分析学派的创始人，其理论体系彻底改变了人类对心理的理解，提出潜意识/梦的解析/性心理学等概念，成为20世纪心理学/文化研究/哲学领域最重要的理论之一。
reason_en: Freud was founder of modern psychology and psychoanalysis school, his theory system thoroughly changed human understanding of psychology, proposed unconscious/dream interpretation/sexology concepts, became one of 20th century psychology/cultural studies/philosophy most important theories.
steps_zh: 精神分析学派建立：1895 年弗洛伊德精神分析学派建立/理论体系构建/潜意识理论提出/奠定精神分析基础
潜意识理论发展：1900 年弗洛伊德潜意识理论发展/梦的解析/性心理学建立/理论体系完善
俄狄浦斯情结提出：1910 年弗洛伊德俄狄浦斯情结提出/泛性论理论/精神传导建立/理论扩展
维也纳学派领导：1902 年维也纳精神分析学派成立/弗洛伊德担任主席/学派领导/理论传播
伦敦犹太流亡：1938 年弗洛伊德移居伦敦/领导犹太流亡精神治疗/继续理论研究/晚年工作
steps_en: Psychoanalysis school establishment: 1895 Freud psychoanalysis school established/theory system construction/unconscious theory proposed/foundation
Unconscious theory development: 1900 Freud unconscious theory development/dream interpretation/sexology established/theory system perfection
Oedipus complex proposal: 1910 Freud Oedipus complex proposed/generality theory/psychical transmission established/theory extension
Vienna school leadership: 1902 Vienna psychoanalysis school established/Freud served as president/school leadership/theory dissemination
London Jewish exile: 1938 Freud emigrated to London/led Jewish exile mental treatment/continuous theory research/late work
